entities.name: Perisophia
entities.description: The gray-haired Speaker of the Twelve in Meletis, who decides the missing children must be laid to rest and leads the ritual.

entities.name: Phalanx leader
entities.description: A phalanx captain who reports to the Dekatia that the Weeping Woman is now leading three children and could not bring himself to strike them down.

entities.name: Bearded youth
entities.description: A bearded young widower marked by mourning whose lekythos libation draws the Weeping Woman and her children.

entities.name: Weeping Woman
entities.description: A gold-masked dead woman of Asphodel who, in an endless search for her dead, lures living children away.

entities.name: Missing children
entities.description: Children lured from Meletis who now trail the Weeping Woman in masks and are laid to rest.

entities.name: Anthousa
entities.description: A figure quoted as saying more children were taken and the evil will be tracked without mercy.

entities.name: Priests of the dour god
entities.description: Hooded priests with small golden whips who chant to quiet the Weeping Woman and the children.

entities.name: The Twelve
entities.description: The governing council of Meletis whose speaker is Perisophia.

entities.name: The Returned
entities.description: Dead who rejected the Underworld and dwell in Asphodel, occasionally raiding.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: A god invoked to lift the veil from the seers' eyes.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The night-sky realm into which the children are said to have vanished and whose glow fades at dawn.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: The polis where children are going missing.

entities.name: Dekatia
entities.description: The academy in Meletis where the finest minds convene.

entities.name: Asphodel
entities.description: The coastal marsh where the Returned who rejected the Underworld wander.

entities.name: Observatory
entities.description: A place where seers may discern the truth.

events.summary: Soldiers in Meletis note that a third child has vanished this month and no one knows what happened.
events.quote: "That makes three so far this month."

events.summary: The phalanx leader reports to Perisophia and the council that the Weeping Woman is no longer alone and leads three masked children.
events.quote: We have again seen the Weeping Woman. And... she is no longer alone.

events.summary: The captain admits he could not strike down the children, and Perisophia comforts him, saying tenderness stayed his hand.
events.quote: Tenderness, not weakness, stayed your hand.

events.summary: Perisophia deduces that the Weeping Woman has lured the missing children away and decides the children must be laid to rest.
events.quote: In her endless search for her dead, the Weeping Woman has lured away the living.

events.summary: Perisophia orders the children to sleep, and priests gather to prepare a blood-rite.
At the salt marsh the priests chant while the young widower pours the lekythos into the water, drawing the Weeping Woman and children from the mist.
events.quote: Then, out of the mists, she came.

events.summary: The priests lay blood-wet palms on the golden masks, and the four masked figures slip below the surface of the fen.
events.quote: And with a sigh, four masked figures slipped below the surface.

events.summary: Misty child spirits play through the agora at dawn and vanish into the walls, and Perisophia declares the children at rest.

relations.note: She lures them away in her endless search for her dead and keeps them as masked followers.
relations.quote: the Weeping Woman has lured away the living.

relations.note: She is the Speaker of the Twelve.
relations.quote: The speaker of the Twelve looked out over the salt marsh.

relations.note: He reports to her as Speaker.
relations.quote: "Honored Speaker Perisophia, I pray you will forgive this intrusion."

relations.note: She wanders Asphodel among the Returned who rejected the Underworld.
relations.quote: we left her to wander Asphodel with the others who rejected the Underworld.
